name: ais-vision-systems_carousel-guide-roi_en_2026-11-12
copy: Before investing in machine vision, gather the cost of the problem, volume and defects, manual inspection, integration and maintenance. Estimate net monthly savings and compare three scenarios. Initial investment divided by positive net monthly savings estimates simple payback in months; it is not a percentage ROI or a promise of savings. Tell us about your line.
